integrity: The known count of 30240 feasible rankings and the flow-balance feasibility reduction are prior results and are not claimed as new. The contribution is the exact worst shortest realizing length 86, the count 72 of extremal rankings, and a complete exact finite proof over the 420 length-relevant symmetry classes.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to strict rankings of circular ternary length-two profiles. It does not treat ties, non-circular realizations, or larger alphabet/window parameters. Full text of two highly relevant 2026 papers could not be retrieved during this run, leaving a stated originality risk.
title: Exact worst-case realizing length for ternary window-two DNA profile rankings
